title: Seyllo
description: Connect your Minecraft server to your Seyllo store. Auto-delivery, remote console, real-time monitoring. Free alternative to Tebex.
body:
![Seyllo Banner](https://seyllo.ovh/images/seyllo-banner.png)

  # Seyllo — Game Server Store Plugin

  Connect your Minecraft server to your Seyllo store in one command. Sell ranks, kits, items and deliver them
  automatically.

  **[Create your free store →](https://seyllo.com/?utm_source=modrinth&utm_medium=plugin&utm_campaign=seyllo-plugin)**

  ## Features

  - 🔗 **One-Click Setup** — Run `/seyllo connect` and your server is linked. No config files needed.
  - 📦 **Automatic Delivery** — Commands executed instantly when a player purchases (LuckPerms, EssentialsX, any
  command)
  - 🖥️  **Remote Console** — Execute commands directly from your web dashboard
  - 📊 **Real-Time Monitoring** — Player count, TPS, version, online players visible live
  - 🎮 **17+ Games** — Minecraft, FiveM, Rust, Hytale, CS2, ARK, Garry's Mod and more
  - 🌍 **18 Languages** — Storefronts in FR, EN, DE, ES, IT, PT, JA, KO, ZH...
  - 💳 **Stripe Payments** — Direct payouts, Apple Pay & Google Pay
  - 🎭 **Discord Role Sync** — Auto-assign roles on purchase

  ## Commands

  | Command | Description | Permission |
  |---------|-------------|------------|
  | `/seyllo connect` | Link server to your store | seyllo.admin |
  | `/seyllo status` | Check connection | seyllo.admin |
  | `/seyllo logout` | Disconnect from store | seyllo.admin |
  | `/seyllo lookup <player>` | View player purchases | seyllo.lookup |
  | `/seyllo claim` | Claim pending deliveries | seyllo.claim |
  | `/seyllo stats` | View server info | seyllo.admin |
  | `/seyllo reload` | Reload config | seyllo.admin |

  ## How it works

  1. Create a free store on
  [seyllo.com](https://seyllo.com/?utm_source=modrinth&utm_medium=plugin&utm_campaign=seyllo-plugin)
  2. Download and install this plugin in your `plugins/` folder
  3. Restart your server
  4. Run `/seyllo connect` in-game or in console
  5. A link opens in your browser — select your store, name your server
  6. Done! Products are delivered automatically when purchased

  ## Why Seyllo over Tebex?

  | | Seyllo | Tebex |
  |---|---|---|
  | Free plan | ✅ | ✅ |
  | Commission | 5-7.5% | 5% + fees |
  | Plugin setup | One command | Manual config |
  | Remote console | ✅ | ❌ |
  | 18 languages | ✅ | ❌ |
  | Discord roles | ✅ Built-in | Plugin needed |
  | 17+ games | ✅ | Limited |

  ## Supported Versions

  Minecraft **1.7.10** to **1.21+** (Java 8+)

  Works with Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and all forks.
